system.description:
Materials: Aircraft-grade aluminum body; high-intensity LED bulb; rechargeable lithium batteries.

Physical Description: A compact, durable, and waterproof cylinder. It casts a blindingly bright cone of white light. Many models feature a strobe function to disorient attackers and a jagged strike bezel for self-defense.

Duration: 12 hours (Low) / 2 hours (High)
